definitions.explanation: A pale, light shade of blue, like the color of clear shallow water. One of the traditional Japanese color names.

examples.japanese: {水色|みずいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She's wearing a light blue dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{水色|みずいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{澄|す}んでいた→澄む：13370_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The sky was a clear light blue.
The child drew a picture of the sea with a light blue crayon.

notes:
USAGE:
A common, everyday color word. Used as a noun ({水色|みずいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧) or as a no-adjective to modify nouns ({水色|みずいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水色|みずいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (light blue sky)
- {水色|みずいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (light blue clothing)
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{水色|みずいろ} (pale light blue)

FORMS:
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). Literally "water color," referring to the color of clear water.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{水色|みずいろ} is lighter and paler than ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue). It is closer to what English speakers might call "sky blue" or "baby blue."
